messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Gabapentin works by calming overactive electrical signals in the brain and nervous system.
Gabapentin does this by binding to the alpha-2-delta subunit of calcium channels in nerve cells.
This subunit is thought to normalize chemical signals nerves send to each other.
This results in a calmer, less excitable nerve circuit.
That same effect helps in different ways depending on what gabapentin is treating:
Epilepsy - dampens the runaway electrical firing that causes seizures.
Postherpetic neuralgia (shingles nerve pain) - reduces the abnormal pain signals from nerves damaged by shingles.
Restless legs syndrome (gabapentin enacarbil / Horizant) has an exact mechanism that is less clear.
The same calming effect on overactive nerves is thought to ease the urge-to-move sensation.
Gabapentin is not an opioid, sedative, or anti-inflammatory painkiller.
Gabapentin works directly on the nerves.
Gabapentin helps nerve-related pain.
Gabapentin isn't useful for everyday pain like headaches or sprains.
Most people need 1 to 2 weeks of regular dosing for the full effect to build up.
Triplet: ["Gabapentin", "acts directly on", "nerves"]

The relation 'acts directly on' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug interacts directly with the entity specified by the object, typically at a cellular or molecular level.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
B. 'has mechanism of action': The subject drug produces its therapeutic effect through the biological mechanism specified by the object entity.
C. 'acts in': The subject drug exerts its effects within the anatomical or physiological system specified by the object entity.
D. 'similar to': The subject drug is related to or an alternative for the drug specified by the object entity.
E. 'metabolized by': The subject drug is metabolized by the enzyme or protein specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
